caveat: Measured in PCC 7942 on solid BG-11 plates, not in liquid culture and not in UTEX 2973. Wild-type samples only; the kaiABC knock-out arm of the same deposit is not shipped. The deposited count columns are coded MJ2 to MJ50 and are matched to samples through the GEO !Sample_description field.
